what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1176489 refugees from the country, and Uganda hosts the largest share, 54.8%.
Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in many periods since 1964, at war level in several years including 2017 and 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the groups fighting the government include M23, the AFC and the CNPSC, among others.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure rose from 58700 in 1964 to 1176489 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025; earlier big changes came in the late 1970s and in the late 1990s.
Returns to the country were highest in 1978 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers are counted in a separate series.
People displaced inside the country are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
